business_summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. is the largest outsourced semiconductor assembly and test provider, listed in Taiwan with an NYSE ADR line under ASX. Like Amkor it packages and tests silicon it does not fabricate, but at greater scale and with a materials and EMS business alongside the core assembly and test line.

It is the direct listed comparable to Amkor on the same link, and the fact that one of the two is fully measurable and the other is not is a property of the fetch plane rather than of the businesses.
